google my business qr code for reviews: jis dukaan ke zyada reviews, grahak usi ke paas jaata hai. Counter par bas ek cheez rakhiye aur do aadatein daaliye. ⭐

1. Review wala QR code: Google Business Profile kholiye, Read reviews mein jaaiye, phir Get more reviews dabaiye. Wahan link bhi milega aur QR code bhi (QR desktop browser se milta hai). Print karke counter par lagaiye, bill par bhi chhaap dijiye.

2. Sahi waqt par poochhiye: jab grahak khush hokar thank you bole, usi pal. Bas itna kahiye, "achha laga to Google par do line likh dijiye." Review ke badle discount mat dijiye, ye Google ke rule ke khilaf hai.

3. Har review ka jawab: achhe review par naam lekar thank you. Bure review par shaanti se, ek din ke andar. Naye grahak dekhte hain ki maalik sunta hai.

Save kar lijiye, kal se hi shuru kijiye. Comment mein bataiye, aapki dukaan par abhi kitne reviews hain? 👇
